newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing retail sales up 12.8 pct in Jan-March.
newsitem.headline: Beijing retail sales up 12.8 pct in Jan-March.

text.p: Retail sales in China's capital, Beijing, reached 24.09 billion yuan ($2.9 billion) in the first three months, the Financial News said on Tuesday.
This was an increase of 12.8 percent compared with the same period a year ago, or a real increase of 6.9 percent after adjusting for inflation, it said.

The newspaper attributed the increase to soaring purchases of items for daily use, rising by 29.7 percent. Sales of food increased by 1.1 percent and clothing purchases rose 1.9 percent compared with the same year-ago period.
